summary: Second-pass gap audit — find ANY remaining missing corpora across NRMs / sub-traditions / ancient-extinct / esoteric / Latin-American / pre-Christian European

result.summary: Pass-2 surfaced 53 candidate gaps across 6 regions (NRMs, sub-traditions of covered religions, ancient extinct, esoteric/occult, Latin American syncretic, pre-Christian European/Caucasian/Central Asian). After deduplication and merging the two Swedenborgian proposals, 22 are HIGH priority with vault docs ready to assign (the strongest cluster is Buddhist sub-traditions: Tibetan Vajrayana, Pure Land, Madhyamaka, Yogacara, Chinese Mahayana — all have multiple unrouted docs already in vault, plus Akbari/Hasidic gaps and the Rosicrucian/Freemasonry/Renaissance-Magic/Western-Alchemy esoteric block where ~25 vault docs sit unrouted). MEDIUM priority adds (Lane A queue) cluster around Latin American syncretism (Candomblé, Umbanda, Santa Muerte, Espiritismo, Guadalupan, Palo Mayombe, 21 Divisiones, María Lionza) and pre-Christian European substrate (Baltic, Slavic, Armenian, Nart sagas, Tocharian Buddhism, Sogdian, Anglo-Saxon heathenry, Coptic, Armenian Apostolic). LOW/SKIP includes UFO religions, apocalyptic cult canon, Nabataean/Palmyrene epigraphic-only corpora, Curanderismo (medical/sacred border), Abakuá, Quimbanda, Sámi (oral-substrate), Georgian Kartvelian, Rajneesh sermon-canon, and OTO/Fortune which overlap with thelema-corpus. Two genuine overlaps flagged: the two Swedenborgian proposals are duplicates of each other, and Hindu-modernism partially overlaps with the existing south-asian-modernism corpus (needs Lane A judgement on whether to split).

high_priority_adds.rationale: Three vault docs unrouted with strong Tier-1 scholarship (De Michelis, Foxen, Jaffrelot). Distinct from south-asian-modernism (Ambedkar/Iqbal) — this is Hindu-modernist canon proper. NOTE Lane A: verify no overlap collision with south-asian-modernism scope.

Substantial textual canon with vault docs ready (Kebra Nagast, tradition node, Haile Selassie). Lane A would add Promised Key + Holy Piby. Tier-1 sources (Chevannes, Edmonds, Bedasse) all university-press.

high_priority_adds.religion_label: Tibetan Vajrayana Buddhism (Nyingma / Kagyu / Sakya / Gelug)
high_priority_adds.rationale: Single largest unrepresented Buddhist family. Separate canon (Kangyur 108 vols + Tengyur 224 vols + terma). Bardo Thodol already in vault. zen-japanese-canon covers Zen only.

high_priority_adds.religion_label: Pure Land Buddhism (Jodo / Jodo-Shinshu / Chinese Jingtu)
high_priority_adds.rationale: Numerically largest East Asian Buddhist tradition. Three-sutra canon + Shinran's Kyogyoshinsho + Honen + Tannisho. Vault has Larger Sukhavativyuha ready.
Foundational Mahayana philosophical school cutting across Indian/Chinese/Tibetan Buddhism. 5 vault docs unrouted (MMK, Ashtasahasrika, Heart, Diamond, Diamond-868).
Second great Mahayana philosophical school (Asanga, Vasubandhu, Dignaga, Dharmakirti). Foundational for East Asian Buddhism. 2 vault docs ready.

Three indigenous Chinese Mahayana schools with own canonical texts before Japanese transmission. 4 vault docs ready (Platform Sutra, Diamond, Diamond-868, Avatamsaka). Note Diamond Sutra docs co-occur with Madhyamaka — Lane A should pick primary corpus.

high_priority_adds.religion_label: Twelver Shia hadith & imami doctrine (Kutub al-Arba'a)
high_priority_adds.rationale: Distinct hadith canon (Kafi, Faqih, Tahdhib, Istibsar = Four Books) + Nahj al-Balagha + Sahifa. Current shia-corpus too broad — Twelver imami textual tradition needs own canon (Ismaili already has own corpus).

high_priority_adds.religion_label: Swedenborgian / New Church (Church of the New Jerusalem)
high_priority_adds.rationale: 30-volume Latin theological corpus founded distinct denomination still active. Influence on Blake, James, Borges. Currently mis-filed under christian-theosophy alongside Boehme (different lineage). NOTE: pass-2 produced two duplicate proposals (esoteric region + sub-tradition region) for the same corpus — same vault doc, same canon. Treat as one corpus.
Distinct Eastern Orthodox mystical sub-canon (Evagrius, Macarian Homilies, Symeon, Palamas, Philokalia 1782). byzantine-orthodox covers liturgical/conciliar only. 2 vault docs ready.
Defined manifesto canon (Fama 1614, Confessio 1615, Chymische Hochzeit 1616). Currently in SCRIPTURE_IDS list but unrouted to any of 83 corpora. Yates-canonized as discrete textual tradition.

Recognized textual canon (Old Charges, Anderson Constitutions 1723, published ritual exposures, Pike's Morals and Dogma). Anderson doc in vault but unrouted. Brill Handbook of Freemasonry validates as scholarly object.

Distinct tradition with own Christology + threefold-human + biodynamic + Waldorf canon. Steiner's Outline of Esoteric Science MIS-FILED under theosophy-corpus despite explicit 1912 break from Adyar. Critical re-classification.

Yates' 'Hermetic Tradition' thesis canonizes this as recognized textual lineage distinct from late-antique Hermetica. 10 vault docs unrouted or awkwardly sitting under hermetica's 'Renaissance recovery' section — largest single block of unrouted esoteric docs.

Latin/vernacular alchemical canon (13th-18th c.) — Rosarium, Splendor Solis, Mutus Liber, Atalanta Fugiens, Twelve Keys, etc. hermetica-alchemical only has late-antique (Tabula Smaragdina + Zosimos). 11 vault docs unrouted.

Heretical-Kabbalistic stream that Scholem canonizes as distinct. Vault has Nathan of Gaza + Jacob Frank docs sitting between rabbinic-corpus and kabbalistic-corpus belonging to neither. Maciejko (Penn UP) + Goldish (Harvard) = Tier-1.
Kalevala (Lönnrot 1849) + SKVR 34-vol runo-archive = real textual corpus, not undocumented oral. Vault has phase-8-018-kalevala with Bosley/Pentikäinen Tier-1 refs already wired.

medium_priority_adds.religion_label: Unification Church / Family Federation (Sun Myung Moon, 1954)
medium_priority_adds.rationale: Divine Principle is fully developed Korean-Christian-syncretic scripture. Sun Myung Moon person node already in vault. Lane A would add Divine Principle as document node.

Massive Prabhupada canon (Gita As It Is, 18-vol Bhagavatam purports, Caitanya-caritamrta translation, Nectar of Devotion). Vault has medieval Gaudiya lineage but no Prabhupada modern-revival docs yet.

medium_priority_adds.religion_label: Soka Gakkai / Nichiren Buddhism modern (Japan, 1930 / global SGI)
medium_priority_adds.rationale: Gosho (Writings of Nichiren Daishonin canonical form) + Makiguchi Soka kyoikugaku + Ikeda Human Revolution. Distinct from medieval Nichiren by founder-charisma + lay-organization model. ~12M SGI members.

medium_priority_adds.religion_label: Falun Gong / Falun Dafa (Li Hongzhi, China 1992)
medium_priority_adds.rationale: Zhuan Falun (1995) foundational nine-lecture canon + Falun Gong (1993) + Essentials. Tens of millions of pre-1999 adherents. Distinct qigong-Buddhist-Daoist syncretic textual tradition. Ownby/Penny/Palmer = Tier-1.

medium_priority_adds.religion_label: Sant Mat / Radhasoami (Shiv Dayal Singh, Agra 1861)
medium_priority_adds.rationale: 19th-century revivalist neo-Sant lineage distinct from medieval sant-nirguna-corpus. Own initiation chain + canon (Sar Bachan, Mat Prakash). Spawned Eckankar + Divine Light Mission. Juergensmeyer (Princeton UP) Tier-1.
Murli daily-channeled discourses since 1936 (Sakar + Avyakt). Distinct cyclical-cosmology theology + female-led raja yoga. ~1M global members. Babb (UC Press) Tier-1.

Distinct textual tradition: Shenoute homilies, Cyril of Alexandria anti-Nestorian, Pachomian rules, Apophthegmata, Synaxarium. patristic-corpus catches some Alexandrians but Coptic-as-tradition has no home. Athanasius vault docs would fit.

Own scriptural recension (Mesrop Mashtots c.405), Sharakan hymnody, Gregory of Narek (Vatican Doctor of Church 2015), Khorenatsi, Koryun, Elishe. Earliest state Christianity (301 CE). No vault docs yet — Lane A queue.

medium_priority_adds.religion_label: Hasidic Judaism (Tanya / Likutey Moharan / Noam Elimelech)
medium_priority_adds.rationale: Distinct teaching corpus separate from rabbinic and kabbalistic: Besht traditions, Schneur Zalman's Tanya (Chabad), Nachman of Breslov, Elimelech of Lizhensk, Kotzker. Millions of adherents. Idel/Etkes/Loewenthal = Tier-1.

~7-century commentarial tradition propagating wahdat al-wujud across Ottoman/Persian/Mughal worlds (Qunawi, Jandi, Qaysari, Jami, Nabulusi). Most influential Sufi metaphysical lineage. Ibn Arabi Fusus vault doc would seed.

Etrusca Disciplina (Libri Haruspicini/Fulgurales/Rituales) via Cicero + Pliny; Brontoscopic Calendar via John Lydus; Liber Linteus (longest extant Etruscan ritual text); Piacenza Liver. Turfa (Cambridge UP) Tier-1.

Sanchuniathon via Philo of Byblos (Eusebius PE I.9-10); Marseille + Carthage Tariffs (KAI 69, 74-76); Pyrgi Tablets bilingual; KAI inscriptions. Iron Age West-Semitic distinct from Bronze Age Ugaritic already covered.

medium_priority_adds.religion_label: Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn
medium_priority_adds.rationale: Cipher Manuscripts + Mathers/Westcott rituals (Regardie 1937-40 4 vols) + Liber 777 + Concourse of the Forces. Owen (Chicago) Tier-1. No vault docs yet but bounded canon. Distinct from Thelema.
Beelzebub's Tales + Meetings with Remarkable Men + Ouspensky's In Search of the Miraculous. Distinct from Theosophy/Anthroposophy/Sufism. Webb (Putnam) definitive. No vault docs yet.
Kardec pentalogy (Le Livre des Esprits 1857 etc.) codified textual canon underpinning Brazilian FEB + Caribbean Mesa Blanca. Hess (Penn State) Tier-1.

Zélio de Moraes 1908 founding + Matta e Silva Umbanda de Todos Nós (1956) + Sete Linhas + orixá-saint syncretism manuals. MASSIVE-WINS node bridging Yoruba/Bantu/Kardec/Catholic/Indigenous. Brown (Columbia) Tier-1.

Largest Afro-Brazilian initiatic tradition currently INVISIBLE despite Ifá/Vodou/Santería being wired. Carneiro 1948 + Verger 1957 + Bastide 1958-60 = Tier-1 codification. Saint-orixá syncretism table is canonical textual artifact.
Codified prayer books since 1960s (Romo's Ritual 1998 + Rezos chapbook tradition + seven-color veladora doctrine). ~10-12M adherents per Chesnut (Oxford UP) Tier-1.
Nican Mopohua (1649) canonical Nahuatl Marian narrative fusing Catholic Mariology + Tonantzin/Coatlicue. Major MASSIVE-WINS node. Brading (Cambridge) + Lafaye (Chicago) Tier-1.

Distinct from Yoruba-Santería: BaKongo dikenga firma cosmograms + patipemba + prenda/nganga consecration + Nzambi/Sarabanda/Kobayende pantheon. Cabrera El Monte (1954) + Ochoa (California 2010) Tier-1.

Structurally distinct from Haitian Vodou: 21 metresas/misterios in Rada/Petró/India/Negra/Blanca divisions; Belie Belcán/Anaísa Pyé/Candelo Sedifé pantheon. Sanse PR branch wedded to Mesa Blanca. Davis + Deive Tier-1.

Tres Potencias (María Lionza + Negro Felipe + Cacique Guaicaipuro) fusing Catholic Marian + Afro-Venezuelan + Indigenous Caquetío. Pollak-Eltz (UCAB) + Ferrándiz (Deusto) Tier-1. Distinct from any other LatAm syncretism.

Adjacent but not identical to Kardec: Hydesville 1848 + Andrew Jackson Davis Principles of Nature 1847 + NSAC Nine Principles 1899 + Conan Doyle History 1926. Parent-tradition of Theosophy + New Thought + channeling. Braude (Indiana) Tier-1.

Tocharian A + B Buddhist corpus from Turfan/Kucha — Maitreyasamiti-Nāṭaka, Udānavarga, Karmavibhaṅga, jātakas. Thousands of manuscript fragments. Extinct Indo-European Buddhist sub-tradition. Sieg/Siegling + Pinault + Peyrot Tier-1.
Sogdian-language Zoroastrian + Manichaean + Christian + Buddhist texts from Turfan/Dunhuang. Unique Iranian crossroads tradition. Sims-Williams + Sundermann + Yoshida Tier-1.

Beowulf + Nine Herbs Charm + Lacnunga metrical charms + Maxims + Solomon and Saturn + Æcerbot + Bede HE ii.13. Recognized scholarly canon of survivals distinct from Norse-Eddic. North (Cambridge) Tier-1.

Latvju Dainas (Barons 1894-1915, ~218K quatrains — densest folk-religious archive in Europe) + Lithuanian dainos + Sudovian Book + Grunau Prussian Chronicle + Constitutiones Synodales Samogitiae. Romuva canonizes. Vėlius 4-vol Sources Tier-1.

Primary Chronicle (Vladimir's pantheon) + Igor Tale + Helmold Chronica Slavorum + Saxo Bk XIV + Zbruch idol. Must tag Book of Veles as 1950s fabrication per deviant-bridge tiering memory. Gieysztor + Aitamurto (Routledge) Tier-1.

Khorenatsi preserves Vahagn birth-hymn + Agathangelos catalogues destroyed temples + Eznik of Kolb refutation + Tiridates/Anahit material. Heavily Iranicized but distinct. Russell (Harvard Iranian Series) + Petrosyan Tier-1.

Documented heroic-religious corpus across Ossetian/Circassian/Abkhaz recensions. Dumézilian scholarship treats as closest witness to Scytho-Sarmatian-Alanic Iranian mythology (Wærzæron cup as Grail antecedent). Colarusso (Princeton) Tier-1.

low_or_skip: rajneesh-osho-corpus — 650+ recorded discourse transcripts, no foundational scripture, doctrinally amorphous. Goblin's own LOW flag confirmed.

ufo-religions-corpus — Raelism/Aetherius/Heaven's Gate/Unarius. Canonical texts exist but contested/marginal scholarship; bundling four movements signals corpus is too thin to stand alone. Goblin flagged LOW.

apocalyptic-cult-canon-corpus — Branch Davidians/Peoples Temple/Family International. Historically important but doctrinally peripheral; canon preserved mainly in scholarly archives. Goblin self-flagged as possibly belonging in broader 'cult-canon' bucket. SKIP standalone status.
nabataean-corpus — Primarily epigraphic (no narrative sacred book survives). Marginal under John's criterion. Goblin flagged LOW pending Lane A decision on epigraphic-only corpora.
palmyrene-corpus — Same epigraphic-only constraint as Nabataean. Tariff Inscription + temple dedications but no narrative scripture. LOW pending Lane A judgement.

ordo-templi-orientis-corpus — Goblin explicitly notes overlap with existing thelema-corpus; arguably OTO is sub-tradition not standalone. Flag for Lane A: merge into thelema-corpus rather than spawn new.
fortune-inner-light-corpus — Dion Fortune Society of the Inner Light. Niche British esoteric order, clearly bounded canon but no vault docs and audience overlaps with golden-dawn-corpus. LOW.
martinism-corpus — Pasqually + Saint-Martin + Papus. Clear canon and Tier-1 scholarship (Faivre) but no vault docs and small footprint. LOW pending Lane A demand.
curanderismo-corpus — Border-zone: contested whether 'sacred-textual' or 'medical' per goblin. Códice Badianus is herbal pharmacopeia. SKIP unless Lane A explicitly wants medical-religious bridges.
abakua-corpus — Niche Cross River secret society, anaforuana script is recognized but small footprint vs. larger Cuban traditions (Santería + Palo). LOW.
quimbanda-corpus — Goblin notes border-zone status; sociologists treat as religion but contested by Umbandists. Risk of overlap with umbanda-corpus. LOW.
sami-religious-corpus — Goblin's own caveat: original tradition oral-shamanic; written corpus overwhelmingly missionary-second-hand. Borderline per criteria. LOW.
georgian-pre-christian-corpus — Smaller documented corpus, niche. LOW per goblin's own flag.
overlaps_with_existing: swedenborgian-corpus / swedenborgian-new-church — DUPLICATE: pass-2 produced two separate proposals for the same Swedenborg corpus (one in sub-tradition region, one in esoteric region). Merge to single corpus. Both reference the same vault doc (phase-6-027-swedenborg-arcana-heaven-and-hell).

hindu-modernism-corpus vs existing south-asian-modernism — Partial overlap; goblin claims distinct (Aurobindo/Yogananda/Hindutva = Hindu-modernist proper vs Ambedkar/Iqbal in south-asian-modernism). Lane A must verify scope boundary before adding to avoid double-routing.

chinese-mahayana + madhyamaka — Diamond Sutra docs (phase-5-002b + diamond-sutra-868) appear in BOTH proposed corpora's docs_to_assign lists. Lane A must designate primary corpus; secondary corpus can cite-reference but should not own.

ordo-templi-orientis-corpus vs existing thelema-corpus — Goblin self-flags possible sub-tradition relationship. Liber AL + Magick in Theory and Practice already in thelema-corpus. SKIP as standalone; consider expanding thelema-corpus scope instead.

akbari-school-corpus vs existing sufi-persian + ibn-arabi-Fusus routing — Verify Akbari school distinct from broader sufi-persian umbrella before adding to prevent routing collision on Fusus al-Hikam doc.
